steps: Record the skeptical audit in the writing worker's result.md: compare proposed semantics against the mission and P15, not prototype test counts. Reject silent rounding, timestamp and review-state defaults. Structural checks are diagnostics only. No experiment, performance ranking, accounting-compliance claim or new dependency is needed. This bounded plan survives the audit because it produces inspectable contracts and discriminating examples while leaving unsupported decisions open.

Create progress.md immediately after inspection, within 600 words. Record this bounded scope, actual files, P15-E01–E04 obligations, E05 limitations and exact remaining checks. Preserve all fourteen decision IDs and their unresolved consequences.

Write docs/design/proposal/architecture/evidence-contract-v1.md and save it before proceeding. Address MC01–MC04 and relevant MC27 obligations, principally G2/G11/G17. Specify immutable source bytes and locators; package units and reference dispositions; separate acquired-unit, reviewed-assertion and query-exposure populations; numeric context and faithful display; extraction, interpretation, assumptions and accounting-admission layers; conflicts and unresolved-query effects. Compare aggregate completeness with separate populations, implicit narrative translation with explicit admission, and inferred rounding intervals with source-supported or assumption-labelled intervals.

Save evidence-fixtures-v1.json beside that document. Include a reconciled annual/quarterly/semiannual synthetic package with duplicates, cycles, missing continuations, ambiguous/unavailable targets and resource exhaustion; scoped positive/rejected narrative translations; and known rounding convention versus unknown tie rule versus unknown convention. Use the retained Apple debt/swap passage as a separately identified source-backed scope example. Give exact input records, expected outputs, reasons, lineage and affected queries; do not imply complete Apple semantics.

Write and save time-contract-v1.md, addressing MC05 with MC04/MC25/MC27 interactions and G13/G17/G18 boundaries. Distinguish economic, reporting, publication, ingestion and review times. Define archival exploration, investor-information and system-as-of admission separately from original/latest/harmonised selection. Specify supersession eligibility, selective revisions, calendar/perimeter compatibility and unresolved outcomes. Compare strict evidence requirements with permissive archival exploration; document why publication-to-ingestion fallback is unsuitable for system-history claims.

Save time-fixtures-v1.json with independently specified expected selections and exclusions. Extend the retained temporal example: compatible FY 260 minus revised H1 110 yields H2 150; incompatible-vintage subtraction using H1 120 is rejected. Include missing versus null ingestion, unknown publication, unverified bytes, timezone/date-only boundaries, selective supersession and incompatible calendar/perimeter cases. Label historical arithmetic examples as synthetic and declared date conventions as design choices.

Create partial architecture.json using accdsl.proposal.p16.v1, product_implemented=false, human_acceptance=pending, substantive limitations, the exact hashed P15 coverage reference, inspected source_evidence, and the two substantive contract records with specification/fixture references. Carry all fourteen open decisions forward. Explicitly record seven unfinished contracts and unresolved profile selection; do not manufacture empty or boilerplate contracts to obtain a structural pass.

Write result.md with requirement mapping, alternatives, inspected evidence, changed-file inventory, actual check outcomes and remaining work. Stop new research before the reserved final interval. The stop condition is saved evidence/time contracts and fixtures, validated references, an honest partial architecture/result/progress set, and explicit unresolved decisions. Return PARTIAL for that completed bounded task; if its own outputs are unfinished, identify exactly what remains.
